catalog_quote: In nouns and pronouns word-final stress position, which is found in most words in all contexts, may be regarded as the basic one. It is the usual position in nominals that occur in pause before an intonation group boundary and also in the citation form of nominals ... Retraction of the stress occurs in various non-pausal contexts within an intonation group ... 1.6.3. Verbs (i) The basic position of the stress in verb forms derived from the present base (§3.3.) is on the final syllable of the root or, if the vowel of this syllable is elided when an inflectional suffix is added, on the first syllable of the suffix ... (ii) In verb forms derived from the past base (§3.4.-§3.6.), the placement of the basic stress follows the same principle ...
